title: Choosing a Career
text:
Maria is a student at a big university. She studies biology, but she is not sure about her future job. Last summer, she worked at a small hospital for two weeks. She liked helping the nurses and talking to the patients. Now she wants to become a nurse.

Her teacher, Mr. Lopez, gave her some advice. He said she should look for jobs that she enjoys and that help other people. He also told her that a career can change over time. Maria decided to take a nursing course next year. She is excited about her new plan.

questions.text: Where did Maria work last summer?
What did Mr. Lopez tell Maria to look for?
options: Jobs that she enjoys and that help other people

questions.text: Why does Maria want to become a nurse?
options: Because she wants to be rich quickly
Because she enjoyed helping people at the hospital
Because her teacher forced her to choose it

questions.text: What can the reader infer about Maria's future plans?
options: She has decided that her plans can never change
She believes her career plans may change over time
She has already finished her nursing training
She does not want any advice from her teachers

vocabulary.definition: suggestions about what you should do
the work you do for a large part of your life
a person who helps doctors and takes care of sick people

paragraph_translations: María es estudiante en una gran universidad. Estudia biología, pero no está segura de su futuro trabajo. El verano pasado trabajó durante dos semanas en un pequeño hospital. Le gustó ayudar a las enfermeras y hablar con los pacientes. Ahora quiere convertirse en enfermera.

Su profesor, el Sr. López, le dio algunos consejos. Le dijo que debía buscar trabajos que le gusten y que ayuden a otras personas. También le dijo que una carrera puede cambiar con el tiempo. María decidió hacer un curso de enfermería el próximo año. Está entusiasmada con su nuevo plan.
